name: brass-monkey
description: High-fidelity, audited MCP bridge for Odoo ERP/CRM — multi-instance.
long_description: Brass-Monkey bridges Claude to Odoo ERP/CRM over XML-RPC with a cognitively optimized toolset: breadth-vs-depth search, 360° record dashboards, pruned menu/action navigation, and audited writes (every change captures a before-snapshot and logs a justification to Odoo's ir.logging and the record's Chatter). Configure your Odoo instance in the fields below, or leave them blank and run the `setup_instance` tool on first use. Note: the 30 domain skills ship with the Claude Code plugin, not this desktop bundle — the bundle provides the MCP tools only.

odoo_alias.title: Instance alias
odoo_alias.description: Alias for this Odoo instance (e.g. prod, staging).

odoo_api_key.title: API key
odoo_api_key.description: Odoo External API Key (recommended) or password.
